```plato

    // Interpolates from a to b along the SHORTEST arc: the signed difference is
    // normalized to (-pi, pi] before scaling, so headings blend the short way
    // around the circle rather than the long way. t is the usual [0, 1] parameter.
    LerpShortest(a: Angle, b: Angle, t: Number): Angle
        => Angle(a.Radians + (b - a).Normalize.Radians * t);
```
